title: Security Group Changes

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay sample `aws:cloudtrail` events with `eventName="AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress" OR eventName="AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress" OR eventName="RevokeSecurityGroup*"` into `index=aws`. Confirm UC-4.1.3 returns >=1 row and the alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:cloudtrail` traffic without `eventName="AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress" OR eventName="AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress" OR eventName="RevokeSecurityGroup*"`. Confirm UC-4.1.3 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=aws` sourcetype=`aws:cloudtrail` collected via `Splunk_TA_aws`; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.
spl:
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" eventName="AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress" OR eventName="AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress" OR eventName="RevokeSecurityGroup*"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress awsRegion
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.1.3_security_group_changes_3"
| sort -_time
description: UC-4.1.3 — Security Group Changes: queries AWS `aws:cloudtrail` for `AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress`, `AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress`, `RevokeSecurityGroup*` and returns actor, resource, and region context for security review and change validation.
value: On AWS, `AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress` activity for 'Security Group Changes' is a high-signal control-plane change that should match approved change records and privileged-access monitoring. UC-4.1.3 drives high-priority security alerting before customer-impacting drift.
implementation: Alert on any security group modification. Extra-critical alert when `0.0.0.0/0` is added as a source (exposes to internet). Correlate with change tickets.
visualization: Table (who, what, when), Timeline, Single value (changes last 24h).
cimSpl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count
  from datamodel=Change.All_Changes
  where All_Changes.object_category="security_group" OR match(All_Changes.object, "(?i)SecurityGroup")
  by All_Changes.user All_Changes.object All_Changes.action span=1h
| sort -count

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure `Splunk_TA_aws` with the modular input for `aws:cloudtrail`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.1.78.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `userIdentity.arn` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Alert on any security group modification. Extra-critical alert when `0.0.0.0/0` is added as a source (exposes to internet). Correlate with change tickets.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" eventName="AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress" OR eventName="AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress" OR eventName="RevokeSecurityGroup*"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress awsRegion
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.1.3_security_group_changes_3"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:cloudtrail` in `index=aws` to detect security group changes. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the AWS CloudTrail console Event history for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `userIdentity.arn` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_1_3_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Table (who, what, when), Timeline, Single value (changes last 24h)..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade `Splunk_TA_aws` and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of security group changes so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
